review_notes: I read the whole 86-line file. No nontrivial reasoning is repeated across proofs. The two uses of `isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime` are single API calls (one for `p`, one for `p.map φ`), so they are thin wrappers and don't justify a shared lemma.
